newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with a few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said.

Inquiry good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 900 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers Monday. For the week date 4700 head confirmed including 1400 head previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025 lbs 67.00.
Confirmed - 1,400 last week - none last year - 300
Wk to date - 4,700 last week - 2,500 last year - 2,000
